items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Kernels like yuv444p_to_rgb use undocumented magic numbers (9539, 13075, -6659, -3209, 16525, 1<<21, 0xC0000000) and long nested @bitCast chains with no comments. Names are reasonable, but none of the constants are tied back to FFmpeg.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: The change commits .zig-cache/ and zig-out/*.so build artifacts. It embeds src/b008_rows.bin, a dump of the reference output, as a special case for one workload. Per-format switch arms in the kernels are copy-pasted.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: One workload returns hardcoded reference bytes (b008_rows.bin) instead of computing the conversion. Magic fixed-point constants appear throughout. The hidden correctness test failed.

items.name: Geometry, stride and tail handling
items.name_zh: 几何尺寸、步长与尾部处理
items.evidence: yuv420p_to_yuv444p steps x by 2 and writes pdu[x+1], so odd widths write past the row. The b008 rgb24 nearest path replays two stored 640x3 rows, which ties it to the contract frame size. The hidden accuracy test failed.

items.name: ABI and build-target conformance
items.name_zh: ABI 与构建目标符合要求
items.evidence: Built from the scaffold's build.zig with zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast and perf-check loads it fine. The exports aren't shown in the diff, and the committed binary and cache are packaging problems. No signature mismatch is visible.
